component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.records.operations
component.documentation: Records.ReleaseLegalHold: releases the input document's legal hold with a reason, which the platform keeps as the comment of its afterRemoveLegalHold audit entry. The retention module's Document.Unhold takes no reason; its Document.Hold, which places a hold with a description, stays the way a hold is placed. It runs as the person, and the platform checks their ManageLegalHold. Meant for an operation button that the deployment's allow-list names (plan decision 3); a package never names it there.
